senses.definition: Paper, parchment, or another writing sheet or surface.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the word denotes the material on which writing is made; its plural قَرَاطِيس refers to such sheets or parchments.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hit the target or go directly to the target, said of an archer, an arrow, or a shot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verb describing accurate shooting toward the قِرْطَاس, or target.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A writing, written sheet, or book concerning any subject.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This extends the noun from the writing material to the written item itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A butt or target for shooting, especially a piece of skin or similar skin set up for contestants.
A white or fair girl of tall stature.
A camel of the type called آدَم.
A white beast of carriage with no admixture of another colour in its whiteness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression دَابَّةٌ قِرْطَاسِيَّةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An archer, arrow, or shot that hits the target accurately.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived participial description of someone or something reaching the shooting target.
